reply: Thank you for explaining that you asked for a history of the transfers you sent before your account was closed, and that the request was refused. We understand why you want these records. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including your records request. Please send the request in writing with the date range you need, and keep any statements or receipts you already have. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for listing the four international transfers you sent for accommodation that turned out to be fraudulent. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please notify the transfer provider of the problem in writing for each transfer, with the dates and amounts, and keep the receipts. Reporting quickly gives the best chance of action on remittance transfers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an international transfer never reached your foreign bank account and that the receipt you were given does not match your bank's records. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please notify the provider of the error in writing with the transfer number and your bank statement, and keep copies of your emails. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $4,300.00 check was paid to the bank you visited but you never received the cash, and that your issuing bank has no record of the funds being returned. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep the check and any receipts or notes from each visit, and ask both banks in writing to trace the funds. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $600.00 real-time payment to your card was confirmed by your bank, but the card company says it cannot find it and later says it was returned. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the payment confirmation and ask your bank in writing for full trace details of the payment and any return. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent two wires of $27,000.00 and $24,000.00 before realizing it was a scam, and that you asked for them to be stopped. We are very sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep the wire numbers and your reports to law enforcement, and contact agencies and banks only through trusted websites and phone numbers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you called a number that looked like customer service, and that the person you spoke to took $690.00 from your account. We are sorry you were targeted. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please contact support only through the official app, keep the call details, and never share account information with someone who calls you. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $900.00 was taken from your balance and your account limited, and that you believe your sales met the platform's rules. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep your order records, delivery confirmations and refund history, and ask in writing for the specific reason for the action. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your phone with your card was stolen and that funds were taken even after you reported it, and that your claim was denied. We are sorry you are without money for bills and rent. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep a record of when you first reported the loss, and change your passwords and secure any linked accounts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked to cancel a $200.00 transfer within minutes, were told it was cancelled, and later found it had still been deposited. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. You generally have a right to cancel an international transfer within a short window, so please keep the receipts and a note of the call time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid $250.00 for an item that was never shipped and that your claim was closed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your messages with the seller and the payment confirmation, and ask in writing for the report you were told you would receive. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was hacked, then deactivated, and that $8,100.00 is being held for 180 days while you need to pay rent. We are sorry for the pressure this puts on you and your children. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the emails you received and ask in writing whether an earlier release is possible. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were defrauded through an unlicensed investment platform and that your requests for information about the receiving wallets have not been answered. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including your information request. Please keep the transaction IDs and your correspondence. Watch for further offers to recover lost funds, which are often scams. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,200.00 transfer went to the wrong account, which had already been closed, and that neither bank can tell you where the money is. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the transfers team. Please keep the trace and confirmation numbers, and ask your bank in writing to request the return of the funds from the receiving bank. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that several business payments were held or returned in one week and your account frozen, leading a client to cancel projects. We understand how much this affected your business. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep a list of the affected transactions and the notices you received, and ask in writing for the reason for the holds. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after assuming your mortgage you were charged a late fee and saw double-billed escrow and partial payments on your statements. We understand your concern about the account records. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Late fees can only be charged as allowed in your loan documents, so please send a written notice of error listing each issue. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked to withdraw your mortgage application and have your documents and appraisal sent to your new lender, but received no response. We understand the effect on your plans. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. You generally have the right to a free copy of your appraisal, so please repeat your request in writing and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received a second loss mitigation packet after sending the first, and that you dispute the fees in the $36,000.00 balance. We understand your frustration with the missed calls. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss mitigation team. Please keep proof of when you sent the first packet, and consider free help from a HUD-approved housing counselor. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your monthly payment rose from $380.00 to $720.00 without explanation after your loan was transferred, and that a $220.00 payment was not credited. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written notice of error to the servicer's designated address, listing both issues, and keep proof of payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $25,000.00 lien remains on your title even though the loan was paid in full in 2014, and that it is now stalling a new loan. We understand your frustration after so many attempts. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team, including the lien release. Please keep the payoff letter and the county record, and ask in writing for the lien to be released. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you dispute a foreclosure on property held in a trust and that your requests for documents were not answered. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send your request for information in writing to the servicer's designated address, and keep copies of what you sent and the dates. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you missed your closing because of slow communication, and that your messages are now going unanswered after you paid off debt as asked. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please ask in writing for a list of any remaining conditions and the status of your application, and keep copies of what you have provided. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have received no statements for 21 months and no responses about loss mitigation during foreclosure. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written request for information and a notice of error to the servicer's designated address, and keep proof of delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $540.00 payment was applied to principal and left unapplied, and that late fees keep being charged despite three case numbers. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written notice of error with the case numbers and proof of the payment date, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your bankruptcy discharge, a company you do not know claims a second mortgage lien on your home with documents that do not match your closing papers. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please keep your discharge order and original closing documents, and ask the company in writing to identify itself and its claim. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your insurance check for hurricane repairs has not been released, even though you completed and paid for the repairs and sent the inspection report. We understand the strain this is putting on your family. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss draft team. Please send your request in writing with the inspection report and paid invoice, and keep proof of delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your servicer paid property taxes you had already paid, and that your monthly bill has varied since, with delinquency calls. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team, including the tax refund request. Please send a written notice of error with your tax receipts and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received an escrow refund while your property taxes remain unpaid, and that your payment increased without an explanation. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send the tax bill with a written notice of error to the servicer, and ask for a copy of the latest escrow analysis. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were left paying property taxes after closing, that you were told different things about a tax credit, and that you were charged twice for the appraisal. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please compare your Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure, and keep receipts for both appraisal payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you stopped receiving statements after a merger, that a payment change was not communicated, and that your account was marked late all year. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a written notice of error asking for your statements and a review of the late marks, and keep proof of your payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
